name: @usdk/verify
description: usdk-verify, in JS: independently checks a candidate against declared constraints and evidence sufficiency. Distinct check: (1) every constraint must be in this instance's allowed_constraints policy, (2) every evidence_ref's uncertainty must be within policy, (3) at least one evidence_ref must be present. Neither threshold is claimed as derived/proven - see docs/RESEARCH_REVIEW.md section 1.3.5/5.4 on why no such threshold is imported as a proven constant. Depends only on @usdk/contracts.
